exceptions.exposure_assessment: Token Station does not call VariantStrIter directly. The crate is a transitive Linux desktop dependency, so indirect use remains possible.
exceptions.platform_scope: Linux desktop GTK and WebKit dependency graph. The dependency is not selected for macOS or Windows targets.
exceptions.justification: Tauri currently selects the GTK 0.18 dependency family. Keep this exception narrow and time-bounded until that graph moves to glib 0.20 or later.
exceptions.remediation_trigger: Remove the exception when the Linux desktop dependency graph selects glib 0.20.0 or later.
review_evidence: Commit f1f939a added the advisory ignore, the validation script, and @actly CODEOWNERS coverage.
